falsifier: No one-sided simultaneous 95% lower-bound crossing occurs; the crossing is at or beyond the oracle reference; or it is unstable to a defensible protocol-prespecified sensitivity analysis. SPS-P01/P02 reuse calibration seeds and cannot support or reject the claim.

claim: Irreversible growing geometry changes post-contact cascade dynamics beyond an area/perimeter-matched non-growing control.
falsifier: The geometry-matched non-growing control explains the cascade difference.

falsifier: The boundary shift is non-positive or is explained by information leakage, collector count, swept area, or unequal policy capacity.
